who.en:
For a person going home after surgery or an injury (a fracture, an operation on the abdomen, hip or knee, a caesarean section or a large wound), and for the family member who helps them. The first six weeks decide much of the outcome: the wound must heal without infection, the person must start moving early and safely, and the new medicines must be taken correctly.

The box follows the clinic, not the other way round. It carries clean wound-care supplies for the dressing the clinic has chosen, hand hygiene for the carer (WHO hand-hygiene guidelines), a thermometer because fever and a red, hot or leaking wound are the earliest signs of infection, a walking aid of the type the clinic or physiotherapist advises, and a non-slip mat, because a fall in the first weeks can reopen a wound or break a repaired bone (WHO falls fact sheet). WHO notes that rehabilitation lets people return to work and stay independent at home, and that about 2.4 billion people live with a condition that would benefit from it.

It comes as two boxes: one at discharge for weeks 1–2, when changes are most frequent, and one for weeks 3–6, when the dressing changes slow down and home exercises start.
who.sw:
Kwa mtu anayerudi nyumbani baada ya upasuaji au jeraha (kuvunjika mfupa, upasuaji wa tumbo, nyonga au goti, upasuaji wa kujifungua au jeraha kubwa), na kwa mwanafamilia anayemsaidia. Wiki sita za kwanza huamua mengi: jeraha lazima lipone bila maambukizi, mtu lazima aanze kutembea mapema na kwa usalama, na dawa mpya lazima zitumiwe ipasavyo.

Sanduku hufuata kliniki, si kinyume chake. Linaleta vifaa safi vya kutunza jeraha kwa bandeji iliyochaguliwa na kliniki, usafi wa mikono kwa mhudumu (miongozo ya WHO ya usafi wa mikono), kipimajoto kwa sababu homa na jeraha jekundu, la moto au linalotoa majimaji ni dalili za mwanzo za maambukizi, kifaa cha kutembelea cha aina inayoshauriwa na kliniki au mtaalamu wa tiba ya viungo, na mkeka usioteleza, kwa sababu kuanguka katika wiki za mwanzo kunaweza kufungua jeraha au kuvunja tena mfupa uliotibiwa (taarifa ya WHO kuhusu kuanguka). WHO inaeleza kwamba tiba ya kurejesha uwezo huwawezesha watu kurudi kazini na kubaki huru nyumbani, na kwamba takriban watu bilioni 2.4 wana hali ambayo ingenufaika nayo.

Huja kama masanduku mawili: moja wakati wa kuruhusiwa kwa wiki 1–2, ambapo bandeji hubadilishwa mara nyingi zaidi, na moja kwa wiki 3–6, ambapo kubadilisha bandeji hupungua na mazoezi ya nyumbani huanza.

clinic_line.en: Your clinic or hospital decides which dressing you use and how often it is changed, when stitches or clips come out, when you may shower, how much weight your leg may take, and every medicine, including pain relief, antibiotics and blood thinners, and their doses. Afya does not sell medicines: the licensed partner pharmacy supplies them on the discharge prescription. A fever, a wound that becomes red, hot, swollen or starts to leak, new pain or swelling in the calf, or shortness of breath goes to the clinic the same day; do not wait for the next box.
clinic_line.sw: Kliniki au hospitali yako ndiyo inayoamua bandeji ipi itumike na ibadilishwe mara ngapi, lini nyuzi au klipu zitolewe, lini unaweza kuoga, mguu wako unaweza kubeba uzito kiasi gani, na kila dawa, ikiwemo dawa za maumivu, antibiotiki na dawa za kuzuia damu kuganda, pamoja na dozi zake. Afya haiuzi dawa: famasia mshirika yenye leseni huzitoa kwa maagizo ya kuruhusiwa. Homa, jeraha linalokuwa jekundu, la moto, lililovimba au linaloanza kutoa majimaji, maumivu mapya au uvimbe kwenye ndama, au kushindwa kupumua hupelekwa kliniki siku hiyo hiyo; usisubiri sanduku lijalo.

name.en: Walking aid, the type the clinic or physiotherapist advises
name.sw: Kifaa cha kutembelea, aina inayoshauriwa na kliniki au mtaalamu wa tiba ya viungo

why.en: After surgery or an injury to the leg, hip or back, a walking aid lets the person move early and safely; WHO notes that rehabilitation lets people return to work and stay independent at home. The clinic or physiotherapist decides whether crutches, a stick or a frame is needed, and how much weight the leg may take; the aid is adjusted to the person’s height at delivery. If no aid is needed it is removed and the price falls.
why.sw: Baada ya upasuaji au jeraha la mguu, nyonga au mgongo, kifaa cha kutembelea humwezesha mtu kuanza kutembea mapema na kwa usalama; WHO inaeleza kwamba tiba ya kurejesha uwezo huwawezesha watu kurudi kazini na kubaki huru nyumbani. tiers.en: Regular = the core box with default brands. Premium = core + the premium item. Luxury = core + the luxury item. The luxury item ships once, in the weeks 3–6 box, and is priced as its own line at shelf price, outside the saving (D4).
tiers.sw: Kawaida = sanduku la msingi lenye chapa za msingi. Premium = sanduku la msingi + bidhaa ya premium. Anasa = sanduku la msingi + bidhaa ya anasa. Bidhaa ya anasa huja mara moja, katika sanduku la wiki 3–6, na ina bei yake peke yake kwa bei ya rafu, nje ya punguzo (D4).

services_note.en: Included at no fee (store services): a weekly temperature, wound-photo and pain check-in by phone or in store, and a blood pressure and weight check in week 6. Add-ons with no partner quote yet (R7), so not in the box price: a nurse home visit on days 2–3 (AfyaDepot lists a home “Minor Wound Dressing” visit at TSh 25,000 and a “Post-Op Wound Care Bundle” at TSh 85,000, as market references only), home physiotherapy sessions, and stitch or clip removal, booked with the operating clinic.
services_note.sw: Zimo bila ada (huduma za duka): ufuatiliaji wa kila wiki wa joto, picha ya jeraha na maumivu kwa simu au dukani, na kipimo cha shinikizo la damu na uzito katika wiki ya 6. Huduma za nyongeza ambazo bado hazina bei ya mshirika (R7), hivyo hazimo kwenye bei ya sanduku: ziara ya muuguzi nyumbani siku ya 2–3 (AfyaDepot inaorodhesha ziara ya nyumbani ya “Minor Wound Dressing” kwa TSh 25,000 na “Post-Op Wound Care Bundle” kwa TSh 85,000, kama vielelezo vya soko tu), vipindi vya tiba ya viungo nyumbani, na kutoa nyuzi au klipu, kunakopangwa na kliniki iliyofanya upasuaji.

delivery_note.en: Two boxes over six weeks: the discharge box is delivered on the day of discharge (L box; a walking aid travels beside it), and the weeks 3–6 box is delivered in week 3 (S box). Both pass the D4 check on every plan.
delivery_note.sw: Masanduku mawili katika wiki sita: sanduku la kuruhusiwa huletwa siku ya kuruhusiwa (sanduku L; kifaa cha kutembelea huja kando yake), na sanduku la wiki 3–6 huletwa katika wiki ya 3 (sanduku S). Yote mawili yanapita kipimo cha D4 kwa kila mpango.

pricing_rule.formula: D4 (10 Nov 2026): core price = shelf value of the box goods × (1 − 3% / 6% / 9% for 1 / 6 / 12-month plans), nearest 500, never above shelf; packing (S 3,500 · M 5,000 · L 6,500) and delivery 3,500 included. Check: price − goods at landed cost (R3 shares 78% brand / 72% pharm / 50% own) − packing − delivery − 1% points ≥ 0.
pricing_rule.note: Price per box; two boxes in all. Medicines, add-ons and the luxury line are outside the shelf value. The 1/6/12-month plan savings apply when Kupona is taken inside a household membership; a one-off recovery is bought at the 1-month price.

open.en: Dressings, gauze, gloves and the default hand rub have Kenyan prices only (KES × 20.33, not re-opened); AfyaDepot and Shoppers list none of them. Tanzanian distributor prices are needed.
open.sw: Bandeji, shashi, glavu na kitakasa mikono cha msingi vina bei za Kenya tu (KES × 20.33, hazikufunguliwa tena); AfyaDepot na Shoppers hazina hata kimoja. Bei za wasambazaji wa Tanzania zinahitajika.

open.en: Only three dressing brands were found, and the clinic chooses the type: the box must be able to source the dressing written on each discharge note.
open.sw: Chapa tatu tu za bandeji zilipatikana, na kliniki ndiyo inayochagua aina: sanduku lazima liweze kupata bandeji iliyoandikwa kwenye kila barua ya kuruhusiwa.

open.en: The saline on AfyaDepot is an infusion bottle; R1 should confirm Afya may sell it for wound rinsing.
open.sw: Maji ya chumvi ya AfyaDepot ni chupa ya dripu; R1 ithibitishe kama Afya inaweza kuyauza kwa kusafishia majeraha.

open.en: The weeks 3–6 box has the thinnest margin of the two; if its goods land above about 76% of shelf on average (the planning shares give 63%), it should travel with the physiotherapist’s visit or be collected in store.
open.sw: Sanduku la wiki 3–6 lina faida ndogo kuliko jingine; bidhaa zake zikinunuliwa juu ya wastani wa takriban 76% ya bei ya rafu (makadirio ya mpango ni 63%), lisafiri pamoja na ziara ya mtaalamu wa tiba ya viungo au lichukuliwe dukani.
